mapper.select: SELECT r.*, o.name AS owner_name, t.name AS tenant_name, CONCAT(b.building_name, '-', h.room_no) AS house_address FROM t_rental r LEFT JOIN t_house h ON r.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON r.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON r.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON h.building_id = b.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.*, o.name AS owner_name, t.name AS tenant_name, CONCAT(b.building_name, '-', h.room_no) AS house_address FROM t_rental r LEFT JOIN t_house h ON r.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON r.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON r.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON h.building_id = b.id
AND (r.rental_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%') OR o.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%') OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%'))
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.end_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_rental (rental_no, owner_id, tenant_id, house_id, start_date, end_date, monthly_rent, deposit, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{rentalNo}, #{ownerId}, #{tenantId}, #{houseId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{monthlyRent}, #{deposit}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, o.name AS owner_name, t.name AS tenant_name, CONCAT(b.building_name, '-', h.room_no) AS house_address, DATEDIFF(r.end_date, CURDATE()) AS remaining_days FROM t_rental r LEFT JOIN t_house h ON r.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON r.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON r.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON h.building_id = b.id WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.end_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY r.end_date ASC

SELECT r.*, o.name AS owner_name, t.name AS tenant_name, CONCAT(b.building_name, '-', h.room_no) AS house_address FROM t_rental r LEFT JOIN t_house h ON r.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON r.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON r.tenant_id = t.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON h.building_id = b.id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_rental SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
